thread:
maria_sales: Quick sync — prospect (FjordBank) wants SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning + delta sync, RBAC mapped to IdP groups, and domain proofing for multiple subdomains. They also asked about Dedicated vs Hosted for consistent SCIM throughput and whether we can do delegated admin. Need: short answers for procurement + a security blurb. Who can pick SCIM rate limits/pricing?
dan_engineering: I can handle the SCIM throughput details. We support SCIM 2.0, delta sync, and groups. Default hosted rate limit is 120 req/s, bursts allowed based on plan; Dedicated gives reserved throughput and predictable latency. For pricing we usually ask for expected total MAUs and provisioning cadence.
maria_sales: they gave rough numbers: ~18k employees, 2k onboarded per week during ramp, then 500/day.
priya_se: For the product recommendation: if they need guaranteed onboarding windows during ramp -> propose Dedicated with SCIM burst capacity. If they want self-serve and lower commitment, Hosted with an enterprise add-on for higher SCIM quotas could work.
maria_sales: Can you draft the procurement blurb I can paste to buyer? Also they want confirmation on Okta group -> role mapping and nested groups behavior.
priya_se: Short blurb you can send: "Redwood supports SAML 2.0 (POST/Redirect), Okta/IdP group-to-role mappings via SCIM groups or SAML assertions, and SCIM 2.0 delta sync. For high-throughput provisioning during rollouts we recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) or the Hosted + SCIM quota add-on. We can provide domain proofing via DNS TXT or email verification, and support delegated admin for tenant-level provisioning workflows."
dan_engineering: About nested groups: we flatten to membership sets by default. Edge case: Okta nested groups sometimes include cycles — recommend sending sample group export if they use heavy nesting.
kevin_security: Security notes for procurement: we store SCIM data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS1.2+). For Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS/HSM and we provide audit logs for provisioning events. We'll need the vendor security questionnaire (I can take it) and SOC2 scope — @maria_sales please upload their security form.
maria_sales: Will do. They also asked whether SCIM provisioning stores passwords or any PII in cleartext — can confirm no passwords stored, only identifiers and attributes required for provisioning. Can you add that?
kevin_security: Correct — no passwords. We map attributes (email, externalId, groups). We can redact/omit optional PII fields on request. We also offer SCIM delta sync + webhook callbacks for provisioning events.
priya_se: Small config snippet you can include in the tech-spec:

```
scim: {
  version: "2.0",
  delta_sync: true,
  groups_mapping: "okta.groupName -> app.role",
  rate_limit_hosted_default: "120req/s",
  dedicated: "reserved throughput with burst policy"
}
```

maria_sales: Perfect. One procurement billing Q — do we charge per-provisioned-user or per-sync-requests? They want predictable monthly.
dan_engineering: We bill SCIM provisioning as an add-on tiering by active provisioned employees + optional reserved throughput fee for Dedicated. For a ballpark: for ~18k users, show them a banded quote (e.g., $X–Y/month) and include a ramp estimate if they need burst capacity. I'll ping pricing for exact numbers.
maria_sales: Good enough for initial email. I'll draft and send. Kevin — can you start the security questionnaire and flag anything blocker-y?
kevin_security: Starting now. No immediate blockers afaict, but will call out KMS option and need for DNS delegation details for domain proofing. Expect first pass in 24h. :thumbsup:
maria_sales: Thanks all — I'll update with the purchase timeline and attach their vendor form. Will follow up if they push on nested groups. :pray:
